name: TimeZoneSelect
description: Picks a time zone by place, region or offset — `chis`, `europe` and `+3` all find Chisinau — out of every zone the runtime knows, each with the offset it is at now.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen IANA zone (`Europe/Chisinau`, `UTC`), or `null`. Controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The zone it starts with when it owns its state. Default the reader's own.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the zone's IANA name.

props.name: zones
props.description: Only these zones, in IANA names. Default every zone the runtime knows, UTC first.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The field's placeholder. Not a name — it is gone on the first keystroke.

props.name: name
props.description: What the zone posts under in a form.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not editable and not openable, but still read out.

props.name: props
props.description: Attributes for the `<input>` itself — an `aria-label`, an `id`.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What the list says when nothing matches. Default `'No time zone matches'`.

keyboard.action: Searches by place, region, IANA name or offset.
Opens, or moves through what the search left.
Closes the list, then clears what was typed.

a11y: The APG editable combobox: `role="combobox"` on the field, a `role="listbox"` of options, the active one named by `aria-activedescendant`. A thousand-odd options are windowed, so it opens in one frame.
